intro.en: Ginnungagap, the yawning void between the cold of Niflheimr and the fire of Múspell; from the meeting of rime and heat comes the giant Ymir.
Óðinn and his brothers kill Ymir and build the world from his body; they set the sun and moon on their way and make the first humans.
The gods meet on Iðavöllr, build halls and forges and play at tables with gold.
War comes into the world when Óðinn hurls his spear over the host; the Æsir and Vanir fight and make peace.
The wall-builder and Sleipnir, the treasures, Þórr's journeys against the giants, the binding of Fenrir.
Baldr's dreams, the oaths, the mistletoe, Hermóðr's ride to Hel, and Loki bound.
The great winter, the wolves, the last battle and the fire.
The earth rises green from the sea; some gods return and two humans repeople the world.
